description:
Two more Messenger builds work now, and there's a way to hide the extra settings icon. Still 27 patches.

**New**

- **Hide app drawer icon**, in the App tab. It removes the separate "HushMessenger settings" icon from your app list. Settings still open from the long-press **Patch controls** shortcut and the HushMessenger row in the Menu tab. The switch only shows up when that Menu row applied, so you can't lock yourself out.
- Build **346013370** is supported. That's the APK Morphe Manager's download link handed out, and it used to stop with "version code 346013370 is not supported". It hasn't been tried on a phone yet, since both test phones run newer builds.
- Build **346013354**, APKMirror's arm64 nodpi bundle of 580.0.0.49.91, is supported too.

**Changed and fixed**

- **Allow screenshots** now covers Android 14 and newer, where Messenger hears about screenshots from Android itself, and the photo and media viewers that lock their window in a protected chat. View-once media stays protected.
- A Facebook patched with the same key as Messenger, like Hushfacebook, is no longer turned away when it asks Messenger for its shared message keys. Meta's own rules still decide what it gets. Any other app, or a Facebook signed with a different key, gets the old answer.
- The line under each switch only shows while the switch is on. It no longer says "Not active since restart", which made working switches look broken.
- The App tab's Quick access card mentions the Menu tab row on builds that have it.
- The README explains how to get alerts from only the chats you pick, with Messenger's own settings.

**Updating**

Refresh the HushMessenger source in Morphe, patch Messenger again with the same key and install it over your current copy. Then use Restart Messenger.

All five supported builds (346013387, 346013440, 346013442, 346013354 and 346013370) take all 27 patches, and clean builds from two separate checkouts give the same bundle.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md).
